title: Enchanted Witch Mask
description: A detailed hand-painted masquerade mask with a green and purple gradient surface. The artwork depicts a fantasy night scene featuring a cloaked witch stirring a cauldron, flying pigs on branches, a glowing crescent moon, a distant castle, potion shelves, and scattered pink blossoms.
